# Validation Report Template

**Format:** Markdown Report
**Frequency:** Per Article (before publishing)
**Purpose:** Quality assurance for SEO compliance and authenticity validation
**Generated By:** Validator AI-Human Specialist Agent + authenticity-scorer.xml task

---

## Report Header

```markdown
# Content Validation Report

**Article:** {article_title}
**Validation Date:** {date}
**Validator:** Validator AI-Human Specialist Agent
**Iteration:** #{iteration} of {max_iterations}
**Status:** ⏳ In Review | ✅ Approved | 🔄 Needs Revision | 🔴 Rejected

---
```

---

## Quick Verdict

**Purpose:** At-a-glance pass/fail status

```markdown
## ⚖️ Quick Verdict

**Overall Status:** {✅ APPROVED FOR PUBLISHING | 🔄 REVISION REQUIRED | 🔴 MAJOR ISSUES}

**Key Scores:**

- SEO Compliance: {score}/100 ({status_emoji})
- Authenticity Score: {score}/100 ({status_emoji})
- Technical Quality: {score}/100 ({status_emoji})
- **Overall Quality: {total_score}/100**

**Publish Recommendation:** {YES | NO | YES WITH MINOR EDITS}

---
```

---

Content Quality: {score}/15 {status_emoji}
Internal Linking: {score}/10 {status_emoji}
Technical SEO: {score}/10 {status_emoji}

```
**Interpretation:**
- 90-100: Excellent SEO optimization
- 75-89: Good, minor improvements possible
```

## Authenticity Validation

**Purpose:** Ensure content sounds human and maintains authentic voice

```markdown

### Authenticity Score: {score}/100

**Status:** {🟢 Authentic | 🟡 Moderate AI Fingerprints | 🔴 Heavy AI Fingerprints}

**Minimum Required:** {min_score} (from config)

**Verdict:** {PASS | FAIL}

---

### AI Fingerprints Detected ({total_count})

{if any detected:

#### 🚨 Critical AI Fingerprints (each -5 points)

**1. Contrast Framing**
**Occurrences:** {count}
**Severity:** High (-{penalty} points)

**Examples Found:**
```

Line {line_no}: "{quote}"

```

**Fix:**
- Remove or rephrase to: "{suggestion}"

---

**2. Infomercial Transitions**
**Occurrences:** {count}
**Severity:** High (-{penalty} points)

**Examples Found:**
```

Line {line_no}: "{quote}"

```

**Fix:**
- Remove phrases like "Die brutale Wahrheit?" and "Hier ist das Geheimnis"
- Replace with natural transitions

---

**3. Hyperbolic Superlatives**
**Occurrences:** {count}
**Severity:** High (-{penalty} points)

**Examples Found:**
```

Line {line_no}: "{quote}"


## Template Variables

```yaml
{ article_title }: Title of article being validated
{ date }: Validation date
{ iteration }: Current iteration number
{ max_iterations }: Max allowed iterations (from config)
{ score }: Various scores throughout (0-100)
{ status }: Pass/fail/warning indicators
{ meta_title }: Article meta title
{ meta_description }: Article meta description
{ keyword }: Primary target keyword
{ word_count }: Article word count
{ char_count }: Character counts for meta elements
{ h1_text }: H1 heading text
{ count }: Various counts
{ issue_description }: Description of identified issues
{ recommendation }: Specific fix recommendations
{ quote }: Quoted text from article
{ line_no }: Line number reference
{ penalty }: Points deducted
{ reward }: Points awarded
{ min_score }: Minimum required score from config
{ tov_guide }: Path to tone-of-voice guide
{ user_name }: User name from config
```

---

## Usage Notes

**For Validator Agent:**

- Run this validation after Content-Writer Agent produces draft
- Use authenticity-scorer.xml task for authenticity analysis
- Be specific with revision requirements (quote exact text, provide fixes)
- If max iterations reached, recommend human review
- Approve only if ALL critical issues resolved

**Validation Flow:**

```
Content-Writer Agent
    ↓
Validator Agent (generates this report)
    ↓
{if issues found} → Back to Content-Writer (with report)
{if approved} → Publishing workflow
```

**Iteration Limits:**

- Default max iterations: 2 (from config)
- Prevents endless revision loops
- After max: escalate to user review

**Scoring Thresholds:**

- SEO: Must be >75 to pass
- Authenticity: Must meet config.authenticity_min_score (default: 71)
- Content Quality: Should be >70
- Overall weighted: Must be >75 to approve
